sources.title: Zoo: ML CAD Model Generator | Create CAD Files With Text
sources.snippet: Delegate to Zookeeper Zoo Design Studio is an AI-native CAD platform built on our high-performance geometry engine. With Zookeeper built in, engineers can delegate tasks like research and manufacturability, and let it design around their intent.

sources.title: Model Zoo
sources.snippet: The model is trained on Cornell Grasping Dataset. This is an implementation mainly based on the paper 'Real-Time Grasp Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks' from Redmon and Angelova.

sources.title: Model Zoo - Categories
sources.snippet: ModelZoo curates and provides a platform for deep learning researchers to easily find code and pre-trained models for a variety of platforms and uses. Find models that you need, for educational purposes, transfer learning, or other uses.
